gap: No result ChatGPT got says that three of its four main 1 kWh picks have no battery expansion on the maker's own page: the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic, the Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 and the Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2. None of them gives the per-port solar limits either: Jackery takes only 200 W on one port, needs both ports for 400 W and does not support a 3-panel setup, and Anker cuts input current to 8.2 A below 29 V.
standout_why: Compared against PowerSized (cited), StormWatts (cited), Lights On Labs (cited) and Prepared States (top result). PowerSized has max watts, voltage and plug type per station but says nothing on expansion or UPS. StormWatts says outright it does not cover battery expansion or UPS switchover, and its Jackery data is for the 2000 v2 and HomePower 1000 Plus v2, not the Explorer 1000 v2. Lights On Labs covers expansion only for the DELTA 3 Plus and has no UPS figures. Prepared States lists no expansion for the 'Anker C1000' and gives UPS only for the BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 (10 ms) and the ALLPOWERS R1500 (15 ms). None of them says the DELTA 3 Classic or the Jackery 1000 v2 can't expand, and none gives the Jackery's 200 W single-port cap, its rule against 3 panels, or Anker's 8.2 A current cap below 29 V.
decides: This confirms the plan of picking a larger battery over a bigger inverter, and it strengthens the case against making the DELTA 3 Classic or the C1000 Gen 2 the main home-backup pick. Neither can ever take an add-on battery, so its 1,024 Wh is the ceiling. Whoever expects to grow should step up to the DELTA 3 / DELTA 3 Plus, which EcoFlow's own comparison lists as expandable to 1–5 kWh. For router or CPAP loads, EcoFlow and Anker state <10 ms UPS switchover, Jackery states 20 ms and says it is not 0 ms. On solar growth, the Jackery 1000 v2 kit with one 200 W panel is capped at 200 W on that port and needs a second panel on the other port to reach its 400 W ceiling. The result doesn't on its own flip the pick between the AC180 and the P1800, because I couldn't confirm either one's expansion status from a maker page today.
